landingPage.heroSubtitle: CVForge helps you build a standout CV with AI-powered insights and connect with top recruiters. Get noticed, get hired.
landingPage.creatorsSubtitle: Create a compelling CV that opens doors to new opportunities.
landingPage.creatorBenefit1Desc: Easily add and organize your personal info, experience, education, and skills.
landingPage.creatorBenefit2Desc: Get smart suggestions to make your resume more impactful and professional.
landingPage.creatorBenefit3Desc: Generate a unique code to easily share your CV with recruiters.
landingPage.creatorBenefit4Desc: Download a professional, print-ready PDF of your CV anytime.
landingPage.creatorsImageAlt: Screenshot of CVForge editor interface showing a CV being edited.
landingPage.recruitersSubtitle: Discover qualified candidates quickly and efficiently.
landingPage.recruiterBenefit1Desc: Instantly access candidate CVs using their unique CVForge code.
landingPage.recruiterBenefit2Desc: Connect with candidates whose email addresses have been verified.
landingPage.recruiterBenefit3Desc: View well-structured, professional CVs directly within the platform.
landingPage.recruitersImageAlt: Screenshot of CVForge recruiter search interface, showing the CV search form.
